x-note: Container definitions shared by the integration-test environment (infra/containers/compose.json) and the reference host's demo stack (apps/reference-host/compose.json), so that the images and their fixed settings are written once (FND-010 criterion 2). Each of those files takes a service from here with Compose's `extends` and adds what differs: credentials, ports, storage and labels. This file is not started on its own. infra/test-env.ps1 and apps/reference-host/scripts/stack.ps1 resolve `extends` with infra/containers/compose-extends.ps1, by Compose's merge rules.

postgres.x-note: PostgreSQL 17.11 (PostgreSQL Licence), official image pinned by its multi-arch index digest (2026-11-06). The schema needs 16 or later.

s3.x-note: Versity S3 Gateway v1.10.0 (Apache-2.0) over a POSIX directory, pinned by its multi-arch index digest (2026-11-06). MinIO's server is AGPL-3.0, which the licence policy denies (docs/research/2026-11-06-borrow-list.md section 15).

mail.x-note: Mailpit v1.21.8 (MIT), the development mail sink of the reference host's demo stack (UX-098 criterion 5; owner decision 131), pinned by its multi-arch index digest. The demo file adds its ports and its health check.

export-sandbox.x-note: The settings of the compile sandbox of 09 §9.3: no network, a read-only root, a small scratch directory, no capabilities, an unprivileged user. The image is built from services/export-worker/Containerfile; each file that extends this names the image and the build, because the tag differs. Memory, CPU and process limits are set per job by services/export-worker/src/sandbox.ts.
